The woman in the suit walks towards the camera until she fills the entire frame, as she walks she says in a digital robotic voice:
"Finally here... There's no time to be cautious; I need to find the control panel and finish the job once and for all... Depressurizing..." | Then the white and gold mechanical suit begins a slow, automated disassembly. The skull-like helmet splits into segmented plates that slide backward and fold into the neck collar. Torso armor plates unlatch and dissolve with a fluid contraction motion around the ribs. Arm segments collapse into themselves, retracting upward and tucking behind the body. The motion is rhythmic and mechanical, revealing a female pilot in a white and gold compression undersuit beneath. Hissing steam gets expelled from the hydraulic joints during the retraction. Intricate mechanical animation.
While the suit slowly disassembles, the woman says now in a natural human voice while she looks first to the right, then to the left, as she is looking for something, with a disdain expression on her face:
"uh... If you had told me a few days ago that I would be helping those savages save their colony, I would have told you that you were out of your goddamn mind..."
